caption: Same deployer + salt + bytecode = same address, on every chain.

eyebrow: One job, run per chain, in parallel
code:
strategy:
  matrix:
    network: [sepolia, base-sepolia, arbitrum-sepolia]
steps:
  - run: |
      forge script script/Deploy.s.sol \
        --broadcast --rpc-url ${{ matrix.network }} --verify
caption: One failed chain doesn't block or corrupt the others' deployments.

subtitle: One coherent discipline, from first test to mainnet.
